properties.snippet: Bay of Plenty 25m DTM ArcGIS Image Service which is suitable for analysis and mapping and can be streamed directly using an ArcGIS Client application such as ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Maps for Office, a Web map viewer (browser) or Survey123, FieldMaps etc.
properties.description:
A bathymetry model of the Bay of Plenty (New Zealand) region in 25 m grid resolution. Bathymetry is compiled from multibeam and single-beam data sourced from surveys from NIWA and Land Information New Zealand (LINZ), as well as international surveys by vessels from United States of America and Germany.

New Zealand Bay of Plenty 25m DTM/Bathymetric Grid. This is an ArcGIS Image Service which is suitable for analysis and mapping and can be streamed directly using an ArcGIS Client application such as ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Maps for Office, a Web map viewer (browser) or Survey123, FieldMaps etc.


If you prefer, you can download the file at https://niwa.maps.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=36cb18c3db034aafa16c578e952a16a0


Lamarche, G., Guntz, M., Mackay, K., Pallentin, A., and Mackay, E., 2018. Bay of Plenty. NIWA Miscellaneous Chart Series 109.
